#| label: setup

library(targets)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(glue)

# Locate the targets store via rprojroot (not here::here, which caches a
# stale root marker across the paper folders). The render-environment
# bootstrap (R_LIBS / QUARTO_R / QUARTO_PATH) is set once at the top of
# _targets.R for the whole pipeline, so nothing extra is needed here.
tar_config_set(store = file.path(
  rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("awracing.Rproj")),
  "_targets"
))

# tar_load() the paper-3 targets centrally here so tarchetypes::tar_quarto()
# picks them up as render dependencies (files pulled in via {{< include >}}
# are not auto-scanned). Section files are placeholder-only for now (no
# tar_read()/tar_load() calls of their own yet) — this list is what makes
# the render dependency graph correct from the start of the prose-drafting
# pass that follows this scaffold.
tar_load(c(
  # data and scope (_01)
  qualifying_runners, runners_model_ready, test_predictions_2b, ranking_eval_runners_2b,
  model_2b_exploded_draw_final, going_decile_bootstrap,
  # data / tuning (training side; _02, _03)
  gbt_train_data, gbt_test_data, gbt_race_folds,
  gbt_tuning_results, gbt_selected_config,
  model_3_gbt_path, model_3_gbt_meta,
  gbt_gain_importance_train, gbt_perm_importance_within_train,
  gbt_perm_importance_across_train, paper2b_train_pl_r2,
  # tie-break evidence: grid-maximum refit (_03)
  gbt_gridmax_config, model_3_gridmax_path, gbt_gridmax_meta,
  gbt_gridmax_gain_importance, gbt_gridmax_vs_selected_importance,
  # depth-1 diagnostic (permanently a diagnostic — see CLAUDE.md)
  model_3_depth1_diag_path, model_3_depth1_diag_meta,
  # test-set predictions and Q1 ranking (_04)
  test_predictions_3, ranking_eval_runners_3, ranking_metrics_3,
  ranking_metrics_2a_fresh, ranking_metrics_2b, test_pl_r2_3, test_pl_r2_2b,
  gbt_perm_importance_within_test, gbt_perm_importance_across_test,
  boot_ranking_3_vs_2b, boot_ranking_3_vs_depth1, boot_ranking_3_vs_market,
  # Q2 win-picking (_04)
  model_market_ratio_3_win, backtest_naive_3_win,
  backtest_naive_2b_win, backtest_naive_2b_win_restricted_3,
  backtest_naive_w_final, backtest_naive_w_final_restricted_3,
  roi_diff_3_vs_2b, roi_diff_3_vs_2a,
  # Q3 betting value, single-bet primary (_04)
  backtest_single_win_3, backtest_single_place_3, backtest_single_eachway_3,
  backtest_single_win_2b, backtest_single_place_2b, backtest_single_eachway_2b,
